newsitem.title: SPAIN: Argentaria moves 1.17 pct of Telefonica capital.
newsitem.headline: Argentaria moves 1.17 pct of Telefonica capital.

text.p: Argentaria's brokerage arm on Thursday carried out three deals for a total of 11 million shares in Telefonica, equal to 1.17 percent of the telecommunication group's capital, according to bourse data.
"Argentaria was carrying out deals for clients," said Argentaria's spokesman.
The three operations were carried out in Barcelona, Bilbao and Valencia for a price of 3,265 pesetas a share, with a total value of 35.9 billion pesetas.
On Tuesday, Argentaria added to its own stake buying a further 2.12 percent of Telefonica for 63.400 billion pesetas, raising its share in the group to a total 5.21 percent.
Market sources said Thursday's operation could be related to an interim dividend on last year's results of 35 pesetas that Telefonica will pay out on January 20.
Telefonica shares closed down five pesetas at 3,275, while the IBEX-35 index rose 9.93 points to 5,231.43.
